rationale: Replaced literal True/path-existence pseudo-verification with a complete, validated 25-ID catalogue of NOT_EXECUTED records. Directory-entry observations are separate and cannot authorize a PASS. Absent checkers, UNKNOWN, FAIL and invalid/missing inventories all block gate success in default, JSON, legacy --scitt and strict modes. The present-script maintenance consumer rejects that nonzero status in isolated function tests. Seven original reproductions failed before the patch; the final regression suite covers exit codes and honest statuses. This fixes false success without implementing or proving the underlying invariants.

rationale: Replaced the ID-only digest, formatted pseudo-Ed25519 signature and literal compliance with a versioned UNSIGNED report. Strict canonical JSON and domain-separated BLAKE3 bind all body fields, including ID/status/description/detail, configuration, observations, metrics and local timestamp. Mutation tests with fixed IDs/time and an independently recomputed digest verify content binding. The report expressly says signature None/UNSIGNED, SCITT NOT_ISSUED, certification NONE, legal NOT_ASSESSED and hardware UNVERIFIED. Legacy boolean receipt inputs are rejected; no authenticator or signer is claimed.
